mentions.name: Daily Chinese Stories
mentions.description: This tool generates daily stories for learning Mandarin Chinese, built with LLMs from the ~2024 model era. It is a more basic take on the same LLM-based comprehensible input approach as similar Spanish language learning tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made something similar a while ago for learning Mandarin Chinese. Unfortunately more basic than your Spanish version: https://dailychinesestories.com.
mentions.author: gabriel-uribe
